job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The psychologist from the reference sits in her terracotta armchair on the RIGHT side of the frame, waist up, with a knowing half-smile and one eyebrow slightly raised. On the LEFT side, left-aligned, a large bold serif-meets-sans title in four lines on the warm blurred office background: dark brown «ЗРЕЛЫЙ», dark brown «ПАРТНЁР», dark brown «ВЫНОСИТ», and a deep terracotta «ВАМ МОЗГ». All text must sit between 22% and 78% of the image height (nothing in the top or bottom 22%).
